t: Connectable and expandable decorative lighting kit with 12V low voltage system. Easy to install with no complex wiring. Offers a soft, warm white glow with 10 IP44 rated weatherproof lamp holders for durability against most elements, and IP67 inline adaptor. Ideal for outdoor gathering spaces, gardens and patios. Can be used with the extension pack to link up to 30 bulbs (sold separately).
